name: Jumping on the Clouds
description: Clouds are numbered 0 (safe) or 1 (thunderhead). Starting on the first cloud, you may jump 1 or 2 clouds ahead, but only onto safe clouds. Determine the minimum number of jumps needed to reach the last cloud. The first and last clouds are always safe.
shortDescription: Minimum jumps to reach the last safe cloud
